payload.name: Preserve social relationships from group-activity evidence
payload.description: When extracting or updating memories about a person's group activity, create or keep a relationship memory for teammates or companions so later event updates don't erase evidence of social ties.
content: During extraction: if a statement shows a person doing an activity with a team, group, or companions, create a relationship memory (e.g., has teammates/group members) in addition to any event memory; do not rely on event text to carry the social fact.

During CRUD: when updating or merging an event memory to a newer instance of a recurring activity, preserve any existing relationship memory the old event evidenced; rewriting the event must not drop implied social ties.

solves: Event descriptions that mention a team or companions carry an implied social relationship, but storing that fact only inside event text lets later updates erase it. Extracting a separate relationship memory for anyone seen acting with a team/group, and preserving it during event rewrites, keeps the durable social fact available for future inference. This applies to any recurring group activity across topics.
